## Comparative Questions

How many parties compose Parliaments across the world?

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="30%"}
![](figures/congress_composition.png)
:::

::: {.column width="30%"}
![](figures/house_of_commons.png)
:::

::: {.column width="30%"}
![](figures/dutch_chamber.png)
:::

::::

- [Effective Number of Parties]{.alert} (a measure of Parliament fragmentation): US, UK $\approx$ 2; Netherlands $\approx$ 8
- Why? And does it matter?


---

## Comparative Questions

Why do "similar" countries have different economic outcomes?

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/88/Religious_map_of_Nigeria%2C_2022.png/1920px-Religious_map_of_Nigeria%2C_2022.png)
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b2/Religious_affiliation_by_district_%28kecamatan%29_in_Indonesia_%282022%29.svg/1920px-Religious_affiliation_by_district_%28kecamatan%29_in_Indonesia_%282022%29.svg.png?_=20250916132221)
:::

::::

- Similar population, ethnic diversity, geographic/religious differences
- GDP rank: Indonesia = 17, Nigeria = 46; ACLED conflict index rank: Indonesia = 45, Nigeria = 5

---

## Comparative Questions

Does ethnicity matter in politics? (from Müller-Crepon and Bormann 2026)

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
![](figures/bmc_kenya_cvr.png)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
![](figures/bmc_tanzania_cvr.png)
:::

::::

- Kenya and Tanzania $\rightarrow$ geographic neighbors, same national language
- Kenya: prob. that two people vote the same party $\uparrow$ 40pp if they are coethnics
- Tanzania: almost same prob. between coethnics and non-coethnics
- Why do we see ethnic *cleavages* in some countries and not others?

## Course Structure and Attendance

- Each week covers one topic/module across two sessions
- **Monday**: main concepts (following the textbook)
    - Lecture with active participation expected
- **Thursday**: review and discussion session
    - Review of concepts of the week
    - In-class discussions (two-sided)
    - Applications $\approx$ exam questions
    - Students' paper presentations + discussion


---

## What You Need to Do Well

- [Attendance]{.alert} in all sessions is <u>necessary</u> (but not sufficient) to do well in exams and participation grades
